spendingPlan.title: Daily plan
spendingPlan.intro: Bills and planned expenses are already in the projection. Set one daily amount for everything else, and see how long your money lasts.
spendingPlan.coveredThrough: Covered for the whole plan, until {{date}}
spendingPlan.balanceFloorHint: Days stay green while the projected balance is at or above this amount.
spendingPlan.accountsHint: The money the plan spends from. Loans stay out by default. Credit cards always count: purchases use up the day's allowance and the bill leaves on its due date.
spendingPlan.noPlan: You don't have a daily plan yet.
spendingPlan.noPlanSuggestion: On average {{surplus}} a day is left after bills. To keep every day covered until {{date}}, spend at most {{amount}} a day.
spendingPlan.coverageOk: At {{amount}} a day, the balance stays at or above {{floor}} every day until {{date}}.
spendingPlan.coverageBreak: At {{amount}} a day, the balance drops below {{floor}} on {{date}}.
spendingPlan.sliderHint: Drag to preview. Everything below updates and nothing is saved.
spendingPlan.whatIfHint: Turn them on and off to compare. Kept on this device only.
spendingPlan.legendHint: Click a day to see the math beside it.
spendingPlan.otherHint: Today's entries and moves with no bill or forecast behind them
spendingPlan.lookupTitle: How much will I have on
spendingPlan.receiptTitle: Where the safe {{amount}} a day comes from
spendingPlan.receiptHint_one: Everything that comes in minus everything already spoken for, from today until {{date}}, divided by that {{count}} day. The right column is what each item is worth per day.
spendingPlan.receiptHint_other: Everything that comes in minus everything already spoken for, from today until {{date}}, divided by the {{count}} days in that period. The right column is what each item is worth per day.
spendingPlan.receiptSpentToday: Spent today (already part of today's amount)
spendingPlan.receiptWhyBody: Because {{binding}} is the day the balance gets closest to the floor. If the daily amount fits until then, it fits every other day too. After that date there is slack.
spendingPlan.receiptWhyEnd: The balance gets closest to the floor at the end of the plan, so the math runs all the way there.
spendingPlan.receiptCost: Each {{thousand}} spent before {{date}} costs {{amount}} a day.

widget.spendingPlanHint: What is left to spend today, and until when the money lasts.
